title: Northloop Protect Plans Term Card: Length of Cover, Territory and Gift Transferability
content:
Every one of the Northloop Protect Plans runs for a fixed term in months that begins on the covered item's delivered date; the coverage end date is the coverage start plus the term months less one day. Incidents are covered in the fifty US states and DC, and every plan is transferable to the person the covered item was given to.

## Term card

| Plan | Term | Coverage starts on | Coverage end date | Where incidents are covered | Transferable to the gift recipient |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Protect 1-Year Extended Warranty | 12 months | The covered item's delivered date | Coverage start plus the term months less one day | Fifty US states and DC | Yes |
| Protect 2-Year Extended Warranty | 24 months | The covered item's delivered date | Coverage start plus the term months less one day | Fifty US states and DC | Yes |
| Protect 3-Year Extended Warranty | 36 months | The covered item's delivered date | Coverage start plus the term months less one day | Fifty US states and DC | Yes |
| Protect 2-Year Accident Protection | 24 months | The covered item's delivered date | Coverage start plus the term months less one day | Fifty US states and DC | Yes |
| Protect 3-Year Accident Protection | 36 months | The covered item's delivered date | Coverage start plus the term months less one day | Fifty US states and DC | Yes |
| Protect 4-Year Accident Protection | 48 months | The covered item's delivered date | Coverage start plus the term months less one day | Fifty US states and DC | Yes |

## Reading the card

- The term is counted in months from the delivered date, not from the order date or the date the plan was bought.
- The two families overlap in length: both a 2-Year and a 3-Year plan exist in each family, and only the Accident Protection family has a 48-month plan.
- The territory is the same on every plan: an incident in the fifty US states or DC is inside the territory.

## Hypothetical illustration

A hypothetical covered item is delivered on 2026-04-15 under Protect 1-Year Extended Warranty. Coverage starts on 2026-04-15; the coverage start plus 12 months is 2027-04-15, and one day less gives a coverage end date of 2027-04-14. Under Protect 4-Year Accident Protection the same delivery gives a coverage end date of 2030-04-14.
